prompt.project_info: A dreamy, warm, romantic nostalgic pastel-meadow fashion editorial.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with soft-volume loose dark-brown waves, soft neutral eye makeup, nude-pink satin-finish lipstick, and a serene eyes-closed expression. She wears a powder-blush-pink strapless corset-style mini dress with a structured bodice, subtle seams, and a gently voluminous lightweight satin-or-chiffon skirt; its refined fit complements her feminine silhouette.
prompt.composition_elements: Mid-wide 4:5 portrait in tall green meadow grass with distant wildflowers in soft focus. She sits with legs angled to one side and both hands raised to her hair, shoulders relaxed. No text, logos, or watermark.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft daylight diffused by light haze plus a subtle on-camera fill flash. Gentle glossy highlights and very soft shadows create a slightly overexposed dreamy film look; sunlight highlights shoulders and chest area while realistic shadows enhance the dress silhouette.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm film look, 35mm lens at f/2.8, sharp face and dress with gentle grass falloff, pastel green/golden/blush palette, reduced saturation, fine-to-medium grain, soft haze, halation, subtle natural vignette.

prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, body-part emphasis, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, readable text, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. If approved person, wardrobe, or meadow references are attached, preserve the adult identity where appropriate, blush-pink corset-style mini dress, seated pose, hands-in-hair gesture, meadow, film haze, and flash-fill direction. Individual hair, dress color, and field details may be replaced.

changes: Made the subject explicitly adult and replaced sensual wording with a serene fashion-editorial expression.
